BiblicalUsage: Amalek smote the hindmost of thee, even all that were feeble behind thee, when thou wast faint and weary, and Hushai says, I will come upon David while he is weary and weak handed.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe weariness is when the enemy strikes: Amalek took the faint at the rear, and Hushai would take David while he was weary, and the Bible warns the tired to keep their guard up.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
